@name: Chamberlain
@slug: chamberlain
@source: sohk
@category: RMFRP School of Hard Knocks
@default_cost: 28
@description:
 [Lifestyle] A chamberlain is an official in charge of a sovereign or noble's
 household. He serves as an advisor, administrator and facilitator, keeping
 everything running smoothly while the lord attends to more important matters.
 A chamberlain often finds himself privy to his lord's private business, and
 can undertake quiet missions on his lord's behalf. Time to Acquire: 74
 months. Starting Money: normal + d10 (open-ended).
